## Summary

A venue-specific protocol for cafés/coffee shops:

- **Say "hi" immediately** — when she sits down or you sit down. "If you want to talk to her, but you don't, you can feel it, & SHE CAN FEEL IT = it's '-1' for you and your vibe."
- The hi itself: a little energy in it, a smile, a bit of eye contact — then **back to work**. You're now "in the Game," not mid-pickup.
- **Don't run game mid-session.** Take the shot only when she's packing up to leave, or you are — "you can take a shot, and split and it's not overly awk." As she packs up: open at slightly-above-normal volume ("Sooo.... you working or studying today?") so she looks up.
- **Hold the tension.** If it's on, there'll be sexual tension between the hi and the reopen — "you'll both be thinking about it the whole time." That's good; don't deflate it early.
- If she's seated far from you: let her leave the café, then daygame her outside (the venue boundary removes the trapped-audience problem).

The quoted tweet (his own, to @mortilius_DG's "chick in the coffee shop sits next to me"): "I got laid a lot from 'coffee shop Game' (mostly before I got good at daygame). TIP: say 'hi' immediately when you sit down/she sits down. Just 'hi' (+ cocky look), but it has to be right away. Then, reopen later = it's not weird."

## Why it matters

- **The mechanism is social-frame engineering, not charm:** the immediate hi converts you from "random stranger who might approach" into "the friendly guy from the café" before any ask — which is why the later reopen "isn't weird." Same principle as [[2026-11-02-recenello-start-in-the-middle]]: establish the relationship early and cheaply, act inside it later.
- **The −1-vibe point is the honest detail:** hesitation is legible, and legible hesitation costs more than the hi itself. Consistent with [[2026-11-04-swipehound-balls-over-performance]] — the broadcast signal (comfortable, social) outweighs delivered performance.
- **Skepticism gates:** nostalgia-tinged self-report ("I got laid a lot from coffee shop game"), no numbers, survivorship in the student anecdote; venue-culture dependent — quiet Dubai cafés with laptops and fewer solo women are a different habitat than the US chains he's describing; "hold the tension" is unfalsifiable coaching-speak. Tactic to try, not truth.
- Reference-only: filed as field-craft for the user's own judgment.
